Title: Manoj's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Manoj - 29 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sonali - 64 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vikram - 30 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Manoj stands in the ward. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Mother passes away, and Manoj covers her body with a white sheet.]

Manoj (surprised): "We have to be strong now."
